preconditions.description: The number of polyhedrons in Anton's collection is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(s in ['Tetrahedron', 'Cube', 'Octahedron', 'Dodecahedron', 'Icosahedron'] for s in polyhedrons)
preconditions.description: Each polyhedron in the collection is one of the five specified types.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(faces_count[p] for p in polyhedrons)
postconditions.description: The total number of faces is the sum of the faces of each polyhedron in the collection.
